annotation.title_clean: MICITT inicia formulación de estrategia de Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: MICITT begins formulating Artificial Intelligence strategy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación, Tecnología y Telecomunicaciones (MICITT), Costa Rica
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Costa Rica's science ministry announces the start of formulating a national AI strategy, a letter of intent with UNESCO, and a pilot National AI Laboratory (LANIA). It outlines a methodology and goals of regional leadership, responsible AI, productivity and capacity building. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: MICITT and UNESCO signed a declaration of intent for AI cooperation under the UNESCO ethics Recommendation early adopters network
Strategy methodology: stakeholder mapping, strategic orientation, project bank, action plan, dissemination, evaluation
Goal of making Costa Rica a Central American AI hub with responsible and ethical AI use
Pilot National AI Laboratory (LANIA) presented by CeNAT with fAIr LAC
